# Proposed contribution

## Learning outcome or correction

Describe the concrete learner need and affected content IDs.

## Evidence

List checks run, exact execution environments and results. Separate static validation from runtime testing. State what remains untested.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Original work and asset/source attribution checked
- [ ] Metadata, canonical solution and generated navigation updated
- [ ] Prerequisites, cost, verification and cleanup explicit
- [ ] No credentials, personal data or private infrastructure details
- [ ] Draft/review/execution labels match actual evidence
